messages:
maria: ACME Finance is asking for a sealed-site POC (14 days). Their checklist: fully offline installer, signed SBOM, offline activation (no outbound), delta patching plan, minimal infra guidance (GPU/CPU options), and a short Dedicated trial price. Can eng/security/presales advise?
ishaan: main decision we need from them: full float weights or quantized artifact? Makes a big difference for bundle size and upgrade strategy.
maria: they said 'near-prod' latency but only one rack for the POC. asking for recommended tradeoffs and how disruptive upgrades are.
sam: presales suggestion: offer two options and prices: (A) full signed offline bundle + monthly delta updates; (B) trimmed quantized bundle for the POC with a lower compute profile. Include a time-limited Dedicated trial fee and optional hosted fallback per-token pricing.
kevin: technical notes: our int8 7B bundle (runtime + model slice) ~2GB; float 7B ~16-25GB depending on tokenizer and extras. CPU int8 runs on 64GB RAM but expect higher tail latency. For interactive POC: 1x A100 (40GB) for reasonable latency; for <200ms tails recommend an H100. If customer only has CPU, recommend a small test set and accept higher latency.
tara: security/activation: we can do an offline activation flow with two patterns: 1) customer posts a signed CSR to us during onboarding -> we return an HSM-signed license blob with embedded expiry; 2) manual key exchange (encrypted USB transfer) for fully air-gapped sites. Default POC license = 14 days, extendable. We sign CycloneDX SBOMs by default; can export SPDX on request. Legal needs to approve any >90-day offline key life.
ishaan: patch strategy: we support delta-signed patches for runtime and model slices. Recommend monthly patch windows for sealed sites. Emergency critical patches can be shipped as a signed tarball and applied out-of-band. Typical runtime deltas: ~3-60MB; model slice deltas vary (50-400MB) depending on quant changes.
maria: they asked about warming KV cache without transferring full weights. any lightweight options?
kevin: yes: courier/sync appliance pattern. Provide a small bastion or courier VM that receives KV prefixes via scp/S3-proxy during scheduled syncs. Also support seeding key prefixes via a signed tarball over the maintenance window so they can warm caches without full model download.
sam: pricing note: propose a 2-week Dedicated trial package: flat trial fee (covers reserved GPU and 24/7 POC support) + optional per-token hosted fallback. Add an optional onboarding/installation kit fee if we ship courier appliance or on-site helpers. I'll draft numbers.
deploy-bot: deploybot: offline-bundle v1.6.0 signed, sha256: b7c3d9a1... (signature attached)
tara: CA/cert rotation: recommend customer-runbook with 90-day rotation; we provide rotation bundles and an offline verify script. SBOM provenance: we include chain-of-trust metadata and sign the SBOMs.
ishaan: ops caveats to surface to customer: - bootstrap requires either one outbound call to license endpoint or manual key exchange - model architecture upgrades are disruptive: plan for a 30-120 minute maintenance window per node - sealed mode limits automated telemetry; logs are batched and exported via signed bundles during maintenance windows
maria: great. sam, can you assemble a one-pager: packaging options, upgrade cadence, activation flow, infra sizing, and POC pricing? I'll send it to ACME and loop in legal for the offline EULA.
sam: will post the draft here in a few hours. :thumbsup:
